dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: Oh? You're asking about the village?

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: There's not much to be said about it. It is simply the place where we have lived over many generations.

dialogues.speaker: Komaki
dialogues.text: It's just that this place has experienced far more history than many others... But not as much as Sangonomiya Shrine, of course...
